notes.title: November 24, 2024 Update (v1.4.16.0)
notes.content:
[b]Asha Empire: Exodus - New Update Announcement[/b]

We’re excited to announce a new update for [i]Asha Empire: Exodus[/i]! This update introduces several changes and fixes to improve your gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*][b]Updated Weapon Firing Effects:[/b] The weapon firing visuals have been revamped for a more immersive experience.  
[*][b]Door Stuck Issue Resolved:[/b] The problem causing doors to get stuck has been fixed.  
[*][b]Quick Loot Transfer Added:[/b] You can now quickly transfer items during looting by holding the [b]Left Shift[/b] button.  
[*][b]Weapon Drop Feature Introduced:[/b] Players can now drop their current weapon by pressing the [b]G[/b] key. This feature is especially useful for quickly discarding broken weapons.  
[*][b]Inventory Sticky Icon Fix:[/b] The issue with sticky icons in the inventory has been resolved.  
[*][b]Cosmetic Improvements:[/b] Minor visual enhancements have been made to the game level for a better aesthetic experience.  
[*][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Several minor bugs have been squashed to ensure smoother gameplay.  
[/list]

We’re continually working to enhance [i]Asha Empire: Exodus[/i] and plan to release new updates regularly to improve your experience and bring exciting new features.

Update your game now to enjoy these latest improvements, and stay tuned for more updates in the future!

Thank you for your support, and see you in the Asha Galaxy!
